text: Your app writes events.|Your team needs answers.|Colvenna Isle connects the two, on AWS.
Apps write through one API,|with schema checks, idempotency|and a FIFO buffer.|Need it now?|A synchronous write returns COMMITTED.
Underneath is a native analytics database,|stored durably in Amazon S3,|with native transactions and recovery.
Transform it with SQL and pandas.|Versioned pipelines carry data from ODS to ADS|on Lambda or ECS,|with a watermark at every layer.
Query published results in the Query Editor,|asynchronous, exportable,|and stamped with its data version.
The Admin Console watches writer health|and queue backlog,|and manages scoped, rotatable API keys.
Colvenna Isle,|in your own AWS account,|with backup and restore built in.|Open source, Apache 2.0.
